title: Sloth Reads: an open model reads my read-later pile overnight, then reads me the good ones
why_read: A personal hobby project combining a local LLM, audio summarization, and text-to-speech to manage a reading backlog, pleasant but not technically novel.
analysis: Sloth Reads is a hackathon-style project that uses a small open model to summarize saved articles overnight and then reads selected summaries aloud using a voice synthesis service. The pipeline combines fairly standard components, scheduled serverless functions, an LLM for summarization, and third-party text-to-speech, without introducing new techniques. It's a nice personal productivity tool and a fun demonstration of stitching together existing AI services, but offers limited new technical insight for experienced engineers.
